//: Next.js, so this one cannot extend tooling/tsconfig/app.json: that file is
shaped for NestJS (decorator metadata, CommonJS-free tsc emit) and Next has
its own requirements — JSX, bundler resolution, and no emit at all, because
the compiler here only type-checks and Next does the building.
Relative imports carry NO extension here, and that is the one place this app
departs from the rest of the repository. Everything else runs under node's
nodenext resolution, where `./x.js` is required and resolves to `./x.ts`;
Turbopack does not perform that substitution and fails the build on it. The
app is bundled rather than executed by node, so the convention that exists to
keep node happy does not apply — and the one file here that IS run by node,
scripts/migrate.mjs, is plain JavaScript importing plain JavaScript.
